hook_text: 20 October to 9 December. Can you subtract 20 from 9? No. So how many days is it?
clip_script: Komani, a fridge calendar. Cousin arrives 25 October, today is 10 October. Same month: 25 minus 10, 15 days. Last day of school, 9 December? Break it into three parts. Days left in October: 31 minus 20, 11. All of November: 30. December: 9. Total 50 days. New Year trip on 15 January, starting 20 December: 11 plus 15, 26 days. Use the right number of days for each month. October has 31, not 30.
visual_style: A fridge calendar with days crossed off, months flipping as numbers add up.
mood: Excited and counting down, like waiting for the holidays.
pacing: Quick same-month count, then the three-part method, then the new-year jump.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count the days to your next birthday.
